newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy lira touches two-year high vs mark at 986.65.
newsitem.headline: Italy lira touches two-year high vs mark at 986.65.

text.p: The Italian lira firmed past its 990 per mark ERM central parity rate on Thursday to touch an over two-year quoted high of 986.65 per mark boosted by dollar strength, Milan dealers said.
The lira's previous high against the mark was set in the first week of July 1994 when it touched 984.00.
At 1255 GMT, the lira was at a screen quoted 987.40/7.70 per mark.

"The movement of the lira is being dictated by that of the dollar," one dealer said, noting the dollar's rise on calls by Bank of France monetary council member Jean-Pierre Gerard for a stronger U.S. currency.
